entities.summary: Daniil Vyacheslavovich Yegorov is a Russian lawyer serving as Commissioner of the Federal Taxation Service since 2020. Prior to his appointment, he spent nine years as the service's Deputy Director. He has been described as a leading "young technocrat" in Moscow.
